title: FPS Spoofer
script:
local rng = Random.new()
local FPSEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").RequestData

local function randomDecimal(min, max)
    return rng:NextInteger(
        math.ceil(min * 10),
        math.floor(max * 10)
    ) / 10
end

while getgenv().startSpoofing do
    if getgenv().mode == "fixed" then
        FPSEvent:FireServer({
            Ping = getgenv().fixedPing,
            Platform = getgenv().platform,
            Device = getgenv().device,
            ResolutionX = getgenv().resolutionX,
            ResolutionY = getgenv().resolutionY,
            FPS = getgenv().fixedFPS,
            DataReceive = 0,
            RAM = getgenv().fixedRam,
            DataSend = getgenv().datasend,
            Quality = getgenv().gq
        })

    elseif getgenv().mode == "random" then
        FPSEvent:FireServer({
            Ping = randomDecimal(
                getgenv().minRandomPing,
                getgenv().maxRandomPing
            ),
            Platform = getgenv().platform,
            Device = getgenv().platform,
            ResolutionX = getgenv().resolutionX,
            ResolutionY = getgenv().resolutionY,
            FPS = randomDecimal(
                getgenv().minRandomFPS,
                getgenv().maxRandomFPS
            ),
            DataReceive = 0,
            RAM = randomDecimal(
                getgenv().minRandomRam,
                getgenv().maxRandomRam
            ),
            DataSend = randomDecimal(
                getgenv().minRandomDataSend,
                getgenv().maxRandomDataSend
            ),
            Quality = getgenv().gq
        })
    end

    task.wait(getgenv().spoofDelay)
end
